title: fast: catch stale references and removed modules before push
body: Roadmap R3. Flake census (.krn/runs/lead/weakness-hunt/flake-census.md): 11 of 24 failed CI attempts were real defects fixed by a later push (#259 five red shards, #261, #262, #283), mostly retire/refactor PRs breaking doc or rule tests. Outcome: when a change deletes or renames a tracked file, npm run fast also runs the rule and doc tests that reference it; a replay of #259's first push fails locally.
